verses: When Yisra᾽el went out of Miżrayim, the house of Ya῾aqov from a people of strange language;
Yehuda became his sanctuary, and Yisra᾽el his dominion.
The sea saw it, and fled: the Yarden was driven back.
The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like young sheep.
What ails thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? thou Yarden, that thou art driven back?
You mountains, that you skip like rams; and you little hills, like lambs?
Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Ya῾aqov;
who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
